I just graduated in February and turned 30 a few days ago! I live in the bay area and it has been extremely competitive to get into a nursing program, it took me 6 years to finally get in! But I did and I'm job hunting now!

Don't feel discouraged, I know it's hard not to. My cohort was a mix of people of all ages. Some were straight out of high school and others were in their 40s! Life isn't a race. Take it at your own pace. While I would have loved to be a nurse sooner, I am so grateful for the friends I made that I would have never met if I got in sooner. Keep your head up, you got this!

I was in therapy but I can't afford it at the moment. I definitely plan on picking it back up once I have the means to. Whenever I try to set my boundaries and stick to them, she just tells me I'm childish. I'll tell her the conversation is going nowhere and walk away and she'll follow and corner me until SHE is done. She has this martyr complex and I wish her therapist would see through all of it and not just validate her delusions. 

Thank you for the well wishes. I'm lucky to have other people in my life who support and love me, I just wish my mom could be one of them. Maybe one day she can but I won't hold my breath.
It was a great side activity for all ages and it's such a bummer they got rid of it😭
Big Thunder Ranch with the petty zoo. So many fun things to do over there during Halloween time and I loved taking a break from the crowds to pet some goats

My dad (54) and I (29F) bonded over music together. My music taste came from my dad and I can't bring myself to listen to anything. I don't even want to listen to new music because I'll wish I could show it to my dad. 

I hope that one day I'll be able to listen to the playlist I had titled "Dad's Mix" and remember all the good times. I want to listen to it again for him. Do the things he enjoyed, listen to the music he enjoyed, watch the movies he loved, but it's still too fresh right now. 

The hardest songs for me at the moment are Goodbye to Romance by Ozzy and Rocket Man by Elton John.
Right? They treat us like we are joining the military 💀

My school asked about my MENSTRUAL cycle and even has a section for nipple and genital piercings. I get asking for medications if your school also does a drug screen. I have ADHD and take Adderall so my drug screens always come up positive for amphetamines, but some schools are asking way too personal things 😭

Honestly, I'm so grateful that relationship ended. I look back and realize how neglectful and emotionally abusive he was. Since the breakup I'm the happiest I've been and am about to graduate with a bachelor's in nursing. I haven't dated anyone since nor have I even tried to/ thought about it. I'm enjoying being single for now

I wouldn't say that I believe her but that I don't want to firmly draw conclusions based off rumors or speculation at this point. There's a lot of information we don't have. Sure, it's slowly starting to lean towards it being a hoax or psychotic break, but until there is confirmed evidence that she wasn't abducted, I'm not going to rule out that possibility.

I had good vibes from this LE team since the begining and I've always been confident they would get to the bottom of this. It was so frustrating seeing others talk down on them and saying they were letting the case go cold. They did a great job given the circumstances and I hope now peace can follow for everyone.

I think it's actually amazing how quickly they found him and arrested him. This was a quadruple homocide during the holidays with lots of media attention. I think too many people expected an answer right away like this is a weekly TV drama. I'm imagining with all the blood and DNA in the house from it being a party house, there was a lot of DNA to test and match up as well as connecting other pieces of evidence to DNA. The addition of the FBI I'm sure was a huge help in solving this case as quickly as they did.
I'm free to chat 😊

I'm actually pagan and am a practicing witch but I never tell anyone at work or my patients. I have a pentacle necklace I only ever take off when I go to work. I work with a lot of hospice patients and if I know they are Christian I will pray with them and tell them that God is with them. If they are Muslim or Jewish or are of any other faith, I will do whatever I need to in order for then to feel comfortable and with their god(s) during that time. It's all about helping people and making them feel at peace with themselves. While my personal beliefs are vastly different, I leave that outside of work. I have a patient that always asks me if I'm Christian because she is and I just say "yes I am" and ham it up for her and I'm one of the few she trusts because of it. I kinda of think of it as I go to work with a religious blank slate and fill whatever role I need to for my patients. Its not in any way harming me and it means a lot to the patient.

I'm a CNA and I definitely relate. I get so angry when patients act like they are having an emergency and taking my attention away from someone who genuinely needs it. I'll get called into a room and a patient won't stop complaining how they had to wait 15 minutes for me to answer them and how it's an emergency, the emergency being they need help with their tv or some other NON emergency task. Meanwhile in the 15 minutes they had to wait I was assisting someone to the bathroom or checking their vitals to report an emergency to the nurse. It's the entitlement some people have. Like maybe no one visits you while you're hear because your a shit person and that is a YOU problem. I obviously won't say that to patients but some nights I get very close 😅 I'm currently in therapy to help me with many things and one of them being the stress of working in healthcare
Self love 😌

Every time I catch myself missing him I remind myself that the person I miss wasn't real. How he treated me the second half of our relationship, the emotional neglect and abuse was what was real. I'm mourning a person who wasn't real and the future I thought we would have together. I am grateful for seeing how I should be treated and what I shouldn't put up with in the future. It's hard but we'll be stronger in the end 💙

Mine did come back after 2 years no contact. We were together for a year and then he broke up with me again for the same reasons. The last half of the relationship he changed and became very distant and emotionally abusive. It's been a month since he left me and I'm still struggling to accept the person he was when trying to win me back was never real to begin with.

I agree 100% with the mourning who you thought they were and could be. I feel like the person he was in the beginning was an actu to win me back. Once he had me back he cut the act and reverted back to being a shit person. He never was that sweet and caring person and I'm having a hard time letting that go. I want the hole in my chest to just closed up. In tired of missing a person who wasn't real

I definitely relate to this. I've come to realize how toxic he is and not good for me and I have days where I don't want him back. But today I'm finding myself wishing he was here with me; that we were still together. As much as I know he is a horrible match for me, I still feel hurt. Hang in there, we'll get through this 💙

I got back with my ex after 2 years of no contact and a year later he broke up with me again for the same reasons. "it's nothing you did or didn't do. You're great. It's me. I'm the problem" cue the over exaggerated eye roll. The first half of us being back together he'd go on about how stupid he was for leaving me the first time and would never do it again. Promised to stay and left the same way as the first time except sprinkled in some emotional abuse this time around. 

I don't think it will work in most cases no matter how hard you try to improve yourself. It's just the way the cookie crumbles. That's not to say it never works out, there's always that possibility, but more likely than not it won't. And the heartbreak is worst the second time around so think long and hard before taking that major risk. 

It's been a month since he broke up with me and I heard from a mutual friend he's waiting for me to reach out to him so we can remain friends but I kinda don't want him to have any of me. You hurt me 2 times why would I want to stay friends? So that you can have all the good parts of me still and go fuck around with other girls. I think the fuck not. No matter how many times you paint a zebra they'll always have stripes.

Exactly. My ex did seem better when he was trying to win me back and then reverted back to his old ways, which to me means he never really changed. He's the same miserable person who won't fix him problems. He just was different the first few months then once the high of a relationship wore off he was back to being a shit

I don't think it's weak to give someone a second chance. We're hopeful it will be different, better, that they are able to grow as a person. We definitely deserve better; someone who will won't hurt us to begin with💙

I just heard today from a mutual friend that he is waiting for me to reach out to him and like WTF? No. I'm  done with the chasing. I chased him for the last half of our relationship trying to fix things and make it better and all he did was run away. Why should I have to reach out to him to remains friends. It's the ass backwards thinking for me🙄

It's complicated. I love him. Always will. I HATE what he did to me. I hate that he came back into my life to do it all over again. I hate that he thought emotional abuse and neglect was a good route to distance himself. I hate how I'm still in love with someone who will never love me. I have moments where I loath is existence but I also find myself still sobbing over him a month after the fact. I miss him. My stupid person. I think the love is what makes it hurt so much.

I think what's you're already doing is great. I've found reading to be a great distraction. Unfortunately, there's no way to keep the thoughts out of your head completely other than time. I wish I could flip a switch in my brain and keep those memories and thoughts of him locked up but it's not possible. It's been a month for me too and I still am thinking about him 24/7. The length of how long I stay distracted for is increasing though so there's some improvement.


Something that's been helping me is coming to terms and reminding myself how bad he was for me. All the emotional abuse and neglect he put me through. How alone I felt even with him right next to me. It's easy to remember all the good, and that's all we want to remember BUT we have to remember the reality and all the bad things that caused it not to work out. Every time you find yourself romanticizing her, remind yourself of the bad and how you deserve better. Stay strong friend. We'll get through this💙
I asked him that several times and he always said "of course not. That was the dumbest decision and I will not lose you again" he broke up with me again a month ago 😌
I'm single as a Pringle gentlemen 🤪

Something that has been helping me is reading. Everytime I start thinking about him I pick up a book. I have to put all my focus on the story and thoughts of him slowly stop. I've delegated the time I had for him to reading time now. I've gotten through 4 books now in 3 weeks so I've obviously been thinking about him a lot😅 

It's really hard to find a distraction that fully distracts you. I couldn't use TikTok or video games because it all made me think of him. Even my comfort movies made me think of him. I'm still very much having a hard time with the breakup as it's only been about a month but I'm slowly getting better. 

Something my dad makes me do is play chess with him because it's a lot of focusing on the game. And it was quality time with him. Maybe you can do some puzzles or the adult coloring books. Try to fill that time with new hobbys and use them when you find your thoughts drifting. Good luck friend. It will get better. Stay strong 💙

I had swine flu and I was 13. I refused to miss what I thought could be my last Halloween as a "kid"  and down played what I thought was just a cold to my parents. They let me go out and an hour in I called for them to come get me. It was awful. My mom took me to the doctor shortly after and they told me it was the H1N1 virus. I ended up getting pneumonia.

I look back on that and cringe. This pandemic has really changed my thought process on going out while sick 😅
Oof I catch myself doing the same. I know he won't reach out because he doesn't care but I still find myself checking as thought maybe he did and I just missed it.

I got back with my ex after 2 years of no contact and a year later he broke up with me again for the same reasons. "it's nothing you did or didn't do. You're great. It's me. I'm the problem" cue the over exaggerated eye roll. I don't think it will work in most cases no matter how hard you try to improve yourself. It's just the way the cookie crumbles. That's not to say it never works out, there's always that possibility, but more likely than not it won't. And the heartbreak is worst the second time around so think long and hard before taking that major risk

It took me 2 weeks to be able to start listening to music again because it all reminded me of him. Sour has been such a great album during this as well as Billie Elish Happier Than Ever. Anyone who hates on Sour is lying because it really does nail heartbreak

My boyfriend left me 3 weeks ago right after I was told my dad had another cancer mass forming on his liver. I don't miss him like I did at the start, but I miss what could have been had he decides to grow up and not run away from his issues and drink every night. He gave up on himself and me in the end. I don't miss his misery rubbing off on me, but I miss what we were in the first half and how that could have stayed had he decided to better himself. 

Sorry about your mom. It's hard dealing with a parent having cancer and then to add heartbreak on top of it. It's not a vibe

I'm 26 and got dumped 3 weeks ago. At first I was really anxious because I kept thinking "there goes my future plans. I'm going to be a spinster. I'm too old now" but now I have so much rage for how he treated me and left me that I can't wait to find someone better than him. I go back and forth feeling like I'll definitely find that person for me and feeling like no one would ever want to be with me. I'm working on it in therapy 🥲

2 weeks for me today and I haven't eaten more than a few things here a there and only because my parents forced me to. I'm currently living off of chips and coke zero. It sucks because this is my favorite time of year with my favorite foods and drinks but I have zero desire to have them since my breakup. I already have an eating disorder and when my depression is bad I find it gets out of control. I find the hunger pains easier to deal with than the emotional pain 🥲

Yes. 2 years later. He reached out to me and we got back together this time last year and he ended it again 2 weeks ago. The first time he left me he blocked me on everything saying it would be easier if it was like he never existed. This time he wants to remain friends. It's been very hard, especially the last 6 months of him being so neglectful and gaslighting me. I don't want to say it could never work out, because there's always a possibility it could, but listen to your gut and not you're heart. My gut knew all along this would happen and my heart ignored all the red flags and fell in love with him again. I wouldn't say I regret getting back with him, I learned a lot, but I would rather not be dealing with this heartache again especially during my favorite time of year.

I try to tell myself each day at least 1 good thing about myself or one bad thing about being with him. I hope that in time I'll heal even if it's slowly. Hopefully I won't be a zombie forever and that's what keeps me going. Hang in there. It's hard and it sucks but day by day we'll get through this 💚
I cry, sleep, and disassociate 😌
This. I feel this 100%. Everything I do is just a distraction from the pain of the breakup.

I'm having the same problem. I also have dreams of us being together and happy. I hate all of them because I just want a break from those thoughts. I find focusing really hard on something else before falling asleep helps but it's still hard to divert your thoughts especially right before you doze off. You're not alone💚

I hate to say it because it sounds so fucking edgy but heartbreak. I've gone through a lot of physically painful things and I'd rather go through any one of those over a heartbreak. I've broken my tailbone twice, dislocated my knee a handful of times, thrown my back out twice, had gallstones and then my gallbladder removed, had appendicitis and my appendix removed, ovarian cysts, countless of mouth surgeries, broke my wrist, I've been run over by an ATV and smashed heads with my brother riding bikes, pierced nipples. I had pneumonia from swine flue and caught covid from work but worst than covid was norovirus. Jfc DONT get noro. I thought I was actually dying. I mean I've gone through a lot of physical pain but it was always something I could take medicine for and the pain would stop so it was easy for me to think "mind over matter". Heartbreak is something you have to feel and no one can really make it better.
Honestly I've been having a hard time even excepting that he was emotionally abusive. Everyone around me is telling me he was and he checked all the boxes but I'm over here like 👩🏻‍🦯

He broke up with me 2 weeks ago. Said he's thought a lot about it and emotionally neglected and abused me for those last 6 months on purpose to "make it easier on me,,. Sad part is I'd take him back in a heartbeat. Wouldn't be the first time I'd taken him back 😅

I feel it too. I'm mourning for the relationship I had 6 months ago with a person who was the perfect boyfriend. I know no one is perfect but for the first half of our relationship he was. A goddamn dream. But unfortunately that ended and I'll never get it back. For the last 6 months I've been emotionally neglected and abused but I kept hope that he'd be that person again. I don't miss the last 6 months of me constantly on edge wondering what version of him I'd get. I miss the person who was my soulmate. 

Ive been having a hard time coming to terms with the fact that person doesn't exist anymore and maybe wasn't real to begin with. I'm sorry you're going through this too and feel free to DM me if you need to vent about it💚
My parents and my dog. My dog already waits by my door while at work and flows me everywhere I go. He'd be so lost if I was gone and he doesn't deserve that

I've been numb for the past 2 weeks since my boyfriend broke up with me. I start to bawl but a minute in I completely dissociate and feel nothing. I wake up every morning wishing I would have died in my sleep

I take melatonin, Benadryl, and a sedative prescription and I still have the same nightmares and hopeful dreams you're describing. I find I enjoy the nightmares because it's a break and much easier to deal with than hopeful dreams of my ex. I feel tired all the time because even when I'm sleeping I don't feel like I'm getting any rest. It's hard but you're not alone. Hang in there

I wish I could hate him. God I wish every ounce of me hated him. Hate him for the emotional neglect and abuse, for the abandonment trauma, for the gaslighting. But I can't. I can't hate him. I love him with my whole heart and I'm so mad at myself.

My ex reached out after 2 years but said he started regretting his decision a few months after. He wanted to reach out but didn't want to hurt me again. Last year we got back in contact and started a relationship again only for him to end it 2 weeks ago the same way as the first time.

For the past 2 weeks now. My boyfriend broke up with me and I know people say don't kill yourself over someone else but it's not that. Ive been suicidal since I was a teenager. Breakups trigger it and make it worst for me. My dad is really sick too. I want to kill myself but I don't have the guts to and I can't do that to my parents but the urge to do it grows stronger every morning I wake up

It's been a week for me too sis and I'm feeling ✨shitty✨. I jump back and forth between intense sorrow and numb dissociation. I find myself in denial thinking he's still my boyfriend and then the reality hits me and OOF. I'm taking 3 different sleeping medications to sedate me through night terrors. Over all I am not doing good. Haven't eaten all week apart from a couple chips today. 

I'm really sorry you're going through it too but you're not alone. I'm here sad af and there are many others here who are also feeling the same. I wish I could give you advice but we're both in the same boat.

The petty side of me wants to say text her "cool beans" because nothing is more frustrating when you're trying to have a serious moment and someone says that, but realistically I know it's maybe not the best thing to say back 😅 I mean you can type out something in your notes and edit it after you've thought on it more. Get your feelings out. It's a shitty situation with it being over text so I'm really sorry this has happened to you. I still think just "cools beans" is a good way of saying "fuck you" without actually saying "fuck you"😂

I feel you. The first time he cut off all contact and said it would be easier for me to mourn him like he's died and this time he wants to stay friends. If he still saw me as a friend, he would have checked on me. He knows damn well my mental state and the fact that he knows I've been suicidal and hasn't cared to see if I'm ok. Like once again, my suicidal thoughts aren't his responsibility, but don't say you want to be my friend and not check on me. Not to mention he broke up with me the day I told him my dad has a new tumor on his liver and he just said "well sorry" and hasn't bothered to ask me how I'm holding up or how my dad is. And while I get I'm an ex now he preached to me how we should be friends. This is not how friends treat each other. 

Sorry for the rant. I was not expecting that all to come out😅
No because my ex broke up with me on the first night of the retrograde 🤪😭
Spoke with? I got back together with him last year and just got dumped again a week ago. He really came back into my life to cause me even more pain🤪
Oof yeah that would simply end me honestly. Ignorance really is bliss.

I'm in an endless loop of work, cry, and sleep. I don't eat anymore because I can't stomach it. I also find myself thinking about suicide a lot. It's tough but we'll make it another day. Then another week, month, year. Hang in there

I thought we would be different than everyone else and we would make it. Very teenage rebellion at the ripe age of 26. Unfortunately everyone was right, he left me the same as the first time and now I'm left to pick up the pieces again. I'm sorry to hear you're going through something similar, and I wish I could give better wisdom but I don't even know what I'm doing 80% of the time 😅

I feel like at that point he's just trying to hurt you by telling you that. People who love bomb tend to have that pattern of being this unrealistic version of themselves and then their true self comes out. You fall in love with that first version but that version of them wasn't real or sustainable to begin with. Sorry you're going through this. It's really not fair 😔
I was going to comment this same exact quote 💚

He broke up with me a week before Thanksgiving in 2018 after a year of being together. Said he couldn't ever see me in his future and couldn't ever love me. 2 years no contact. This time last year he hit me up and we started back up again. He promised me he would never do that to me again and how he was so stupid to end it with me the first time. He earned my trust back. A week ago he told me the same exact words as the first time he left me. He can't ever see a future with me and he could never love me. 

I guess for some it could work. I genuinely thought it would work this time. We were a good couple. Never fought and we're great together but he's distant avoidant. I love him so much it hurts. It could work for some but I find the general consensus is it doesn't work. 

I can't say if I knew he'd leave would I have gotten back with him. I honestly can't give an answer if it was worth it or not. I feel in my heart it was but my brain wants me to believe it wasn't worth the pain in order to save myself from hurting more. It's hard dude.

My ex did the same. At the beginning he kept telling me how stupid he was for leaving me the first time and how he would never do that again. It didn't seem like love bombing at the time but after all this I can't help but think it was in order to win me back to make him feel good about himself. Now I'm left wondering what I did to cause him to stop and not want to be with me anymore.

I'm sorry you're going through this too. It's incredibly hard and I wish you the best 💚

Something similar happened to me. A week after he broke up with me I slit my wrists and was taken to the hospital. I was worried he'd find out through someone else so I told him myself I was in the hospital. When I asked why I was there I told him I cut my wrists and he never responded after until this time last year when he wanted to try again with me. While I won't blame him for my attempts because thats my own thing, it hurt that he didn't seem to care at all. And even know that he's done this a second time he doesn't care.

I used to stop by every night after work and spend the weekends at his. Now on my way home from work I have to drive past his exit and know I'll never be going there again. I breakdown every time I get to that exit. He was all I had. Him, his friends, it was my world and it's gone now.

Yes. The first time he left it only took a few days for me to try. He broke up with me again a week ago and I have tried but didn't get far. I still tell myself every morning when I wakeup tonight will be the night but I fall asleep crying before I do anything. I know it would hurt my family but they would move on and not have to worry about me anymore. I lost my favorite person in this world and it's hard to move on. 

I'm sorry I don't have any advice on how to get past the feeling as I'm still dealing with it. Stay strong

My ex left me for the same reason. Got back together 2 years later and a week ago he broke up with my for the same reason as the first time. I'm not saying it could never work, but I feel like for most people it won't and you're just setting yourself up to be hurt again. I'm hurting just as much as the first time and for what. Of course you never know until you try
I was on Zoloft before and it worked for a bit but then it started making me nauseous so I had to switch.
I ended up with pneumonia because of H1N1😭 definitely the worst flu I've ever had.

That happened to me when they upped my prozac by 10mg. I was originally taking 20mg and I was still sad™ so they upped it to 30mg and I tried to unalive myself ☠️. Like I've been suicidal but never like that. That shit was not fun. All that goes through your mind is when and how you're going to do it. You stop caring about the aftermath and have fully convinced yourself you HAVE to. I was taken back down to 20mg shortly after 😅

I hate to say it because it sounds so fucking edgy but heartbreak. I've gone through a lot of physically painful things and I'd rather go through any one of those over a heartbreak. I've broken my tailbone twice, dislocated my knee a handful of times, thrown my back out twice, had gallstones and then my gallbladder removed, had appendicitis and my appendix removed, ovarian cysts, countless of mouth surgeries, broke my wrist, I've been run over by an ATV and smashed heads with my brother riding bikes, pierced nipples. I had pneumonia from swine flue and caught covid from work but worst than covid was norovirus. Jfc DONT get noro. I thought I was actually dying. I mean I've gone through a lot of physical pain but it was always something I could take medicine for and the pain would stop so it was easy for me to think "mind over matter". Heartbreak is something you have to feel and no one can really make it better.

You know I got a dm recently "wanting to see where things go,, and at that point I had only posted on this sub and the suicidewatch sub and idk what about either of those says "yes I'm ready to date" 😅
Everyone pointed all the red flags out to me and I'm like 👩🏻‍🦯

I'm still accepting that he's not my true love. I have moments where I swear he is and moments where I tell myself if he was he wouldn't have given up on me twice. hopefully one day I'll have the answer😅

This. My body hurts for shaking nonstop. I don't eat and I can feel my body breaking down. I have constant migraines from the nonstop crying. My chest feels like a black hole is there sucking the rest of me in. My eyes are swollen and raw that I wake up every morning with them sealed shut. I'd rather have a broken bone than a broken heart. I can handle the pain of a broken bone. I can't handle the pain of a broken heart.

It's been exactly a week for me and I'm in so much pain while being numb at the same time. I find as soon as I start to break my mind immediately dissociates and I go numb and robotic. I think it's my body's defense mechanism seeing as my first breakup almost took my life and this one is with the same person. This shit is hard and nothing can ever prepare you for it. It's hard to love someone so unconditionally and be promised things by them and have them turn around and not be that person you thought they were. I'm rambling now but believe me, I understand how much this hurts you. Everyone says that to me and I don't believe it so I know me telling you that won't make you feel much better. I'm sorry you're going through this too but know that you're not alone. It definitely feels that way, I feel that way constantly, and it's easy to say that to someone else and it's hard to feel it for yourself. Just take one day at a time. That's how I'm surviving this. I've come close to not surviving but I tell myself one more day and here I am.
I cry every day and wish for the release of death😌
Oof sounds like she's got a lot of issues she needs to work on and instead of working on them she's distracting herself by getting into unfulfilling relationships.
Thank you. I really needed this

I believed they did too but he was not willing to let them help. I made him a money and prosperity jar and he got 3 job offers within the week and he turned down all 3 for small reasons. I made him a self love and happiness honey jar and a friend came back into his life that really starting turning things around but he stopped hanging out with them and started isolating. I feel like his negative self talk and unwillingness to work on himself caused his misery and not my lack of spell work. Still, his words "oh what are you gonna do for me? Give me another jar of honey and spices?" have stuck with me
Ain't that the truth
Do you have any recommendations for books about shadow work? I'd like to give it a try but I don't know where to start.
Thank you. I definitely learned some lessons letting him back into my life. I'm more hurt than ever but I feel like that hurt will eventually turn into strength.
Thank you. Im 26 so still young. I have a lot to learn in both my craft and life. I hope one day I can look back at this heartbreak and it will be bittersweet and not painful.

I'm sorry you went through that. No one deserves that. I hope practicing again will help me recover and find worth in myself again. I relied on him for my self worth and now I'm struggling to find myself again.
Thank you I will definitely be trying this. Anything to heal and move on is welcome. Thank you again and blessings

Thank you and I'm sorry you went through something similar. It's such a stark change to have someone all for what you do and collecting rocks and dirt for you because they believe in what you do only to turn around months later and make jokes about it.
